rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: Release dated January 24, 2002: 'The Royal Court has announced that Shaikh Muhammad bin Ibrahim bin Jubair passed away this morning at King Faisal Specialist Hospital in Riyadh'; 'He was Chairman of the Consultative Council (Majlis Al-Shura) from its inception until his death.' Funeral rites were set for after that day's Asr prayer.
